pilot.initialization: All arms use the original broad-distribution step-20000 chosen weights, fresh Adam and RNG; no small-layout phase optimizer or weights carry over.
pilot.primary_comparison: Matched original prepared broad relationships only, full target graphs only, and 20%/50% graph mixtures. Identical updates, point and complete-candidate rank budgets and original losses; only data mixture changes.
pilot.information_boundary: Union original holdouts, remapped target-graph holdouts, all evaluation candidate closures and dense diagnostic closures before filtering both pools. Reject whole decisions. No validation/test relation backfill or validation-based graph weights.
pilot.decision_rule: Do not extend updates or graph coverage automatically. Require paired unseen-layout completion and same-target global/adjacent-layer order improvements, lower cycles and preserved broad-layout retention in both seeds; report layout uncertainty. Loss alone is not a scaling criterion.
pilot.evaluation_scope: Existing small development cohorts stay identical after physical identity remapping. Add fixed 512 queries covering the original 100 validation layouts; all 32-step greedy. Dense fixed unseen-target bank is read-only. Original test layouts remain excluded from development comparisons. No independent final-test claim.

scope: Original shared Q MLP, directed_max, exact physical-step distance Huber plus complete-candidate soft-rank, unchanged weights and greedy32. Lossless packed feature lookup only avoids caching hundreds of millions of unused physical states. Original environment provides transitions.
